specs.Compatibility Options: Smartphone, Headphones, Speakers, TV, Car Stereo System

features: PORTABLE :Pagaria 5.0V Bluetooth Transmitter & Receiver is a Compact and highly portable design Bluetooth adapter, which can slide in your pocket and be your audio companion everywhere. Can be used both at Car & Home

TRANSMITTER MODE: Wirelessly streams audio from your non-Bluetooth TV, to your Bluetooth headphones or speakers. TV Must have Audio Out Aux Port to Connect this device. It can be powered on TV USB Port, no need additional power. Ensure your TV has Earphone Or Audio Out Port, to connect this device to your TV. USB is only for powering the device.

RECEIVER MODE: Wirelessly streams audio from your Bluetooth-enabled phone, tablet, or computer to your wired stereo, speakers, or headphones. Ideal for Car Audio without Bluetooth or Home Audio without Bluetooth. Make sure you have Aux Port and USB port to make it work. Also can make & receive Calls in car with Built in Mic.

SWITCH DESIGN: Easy Switch Modes. You can switch from Transmitter to Receiver or vice versa by sliding the Switch to TX (Transmitter) or RX (Receiver) mode. Unlike other Bluetooth Adapters, this design helps remain in the mode assigned unless you switch or slide to other mode.

CONNECTIVITY: Connects in Transmitter mode with most branded Speakers & Headphones. To put Headphones in Pairing, Kindly long press the On/Off Switch and keep it pressed even after switched On for 6-7 seconds more, and release the Switch once pairing light glows fast on your headphones.
description: Bringing to you, our latest Bluetooth Transmitter & Receiver with Slide Switch Technology. . Functions: : 1)2 in1 Bluetooth Transmitter & Receiver with USB Interface 2)Driverless design, simply plug and play 3)No Battery, Keep it on for as long as you can 4)Switch Modes: Avoid the complicated design of switching modes. Now simply slide the Mode button to switch between TX or RX Mode. Red Light for Transmitter. Blue light for Receiver 5) Input Interface: 3.5mm Aux Port to connect to TV & Home Theater 6)In Transmitter Mode, connects to TV and pairs with Bluetooth Speaker & Headphones 7)Connects to TV with Aux Port (Headphone) only. Do not buy if TV has RCA or Optical Port. 8)Seamless connectivity with most Bluetooth Speakers/ Earphones. Doesn’t connect with Sports Headphones, Unbranded Bluetooth devices 9)In Receiver Mode connects to Non Bluetooth Speakers and receives audio from Mobile, Tablets, Laptops.
